guide: Open Start and type your practice name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the late-cancel hours and fee share, the target booked share of cap, the target load band, the missed-session target and the room use target.
Check Team, Rooms, Services, Room Rules and Tenants. They hold your clinicians with their weekly session caps, your rooms with open hours, your services and the outside practitioners who sublet.
Keep Sessions and Weekly Diary up to date each day. Late fee due, back-to-back flag, free slots and days ahead fill in by themselves.
Read Clinician Capacity every week. Booked share of cap (utilisation, then booked share of cap) and the target load band show who has room and who is above the cap.
List every client of a clinician on Caseload with the usual weekday, time and rhythm. Weeks since last session, days to first appointment and the next session check fill in.
Record each cancellation, late cancel and no-show on Cancellations and No-Shows, each waived fee on Fee Waivers and each client waiting for an earlier slot on Cancellation List.
Log Reminders and Online Sessions. Reminder lead time, the cancel window check and connection problems show what to fix.
Book rooms on Room Bookings, read Room Utilization and Busy Times, and record sublets and their invoices on Sublet Log.
Use Clinician Absences and Rebooking Gaps to arrange cover and to call clients with no next session, the most days late first.
Use the 18 decision tools for capacity, caseload, fees, room use, cover, reminders, sublets and heavy days. Each gives a verdict and a what-if table.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written.
Read the KPI Dashboard and Charts every week: sessions, the three cancellation rates, fees charged and waived, free slots, room use and sublet income.

listing.title: Therapy Practice Scheduling Excel Template: Session Diary, Caseload, Clinician Cap, Late-Cancel Fees, Room Use, Sublets
listing.headline: Fill every slot and keep every clinician at a healthy load
listing.description:
Run the weekly diary of a group therapy practice in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-clinician, employed clinicians, contract (self-employed) clinicians, an associate (works under supervision) and a front-desk coordinator who share rooms and sessions.

Sessions and Weekly Diary show every slot with its clinician, room, format and status. Clinician Capacity compares sessions booked with the weekly cap and a target load band (22 to 25 sessions a week for full time by default), with the booked share of cap and the free slots for every clinician and week, so a clinician with 31 sessions against a cap of 25 is flagged red. Caseload follows every client with weekday, time, rhythm, next session and days to first appointment against your editable 14-day target. Rebooking Gaps ranks the clients to call first.

Cancellations and No-Shows keep three separate rates, the No-Show Rate, the Late Cancellation Rate and the Any Cancellation Rate, with the late-cancel fee charged or waived and a waiver limit per client. Reminders, Online Sessions, Cancellation List, Room Bookings, Room Utilization, Busy Times, Clinician Absences, Sublet Log and Tenants complete the picture.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions with a verdict and a what-if table: capacity, caseload, late-cancel fee, missed session cost, room use, room allocation, online mix, absence cover, rebooking gaps, reminder timing, cancellation refill, double bookings, heavy days and sublet rates. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages.

This is part two of the Therapy Private Practice suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, one flat price with no per-clinician fee, your data stays with you, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data. The workbook holds status only, never session notes or diagnoses, and it does not promise results.

documents.title: Appointment confirmation for a client
paragraphs: Appointment confirmation of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:sessions.client}.

Your session is on {col:sessions.date} ({col:sessions.weekday}) at {col:sessions.time}, {col:sessions.minutes} minutes, with {col:sessions.clinician}. Service: {col:sessions.service}. Format: {col:sessions.format}. Room: {col:sessions.room}. Session fee: {col:sessions.fee}.
Please tell us at least {set:late_cancel_hours} hours before the session if you cannot come. A later change may carry a late-cancel fee of {set:late_fee_pct} of the session fee.
Reply to this confirmation if any detail is wrong.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Cancellation and missed-session policy for a client
paragraphs: Cancellation and missed-session policy of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:caseload.client}, seen by {col:caseload.clinician}, {col:caseload.frequency}.

A session cancelled with at least {set:late_cancel_hours} hours of notice carries no fee. A session cancelled with less notice (a late cancel), or missed without notice (a no-show), carries a fee of {set:late_fee_pct} of the session fee.

The first late cancel in a year can be waived. After {set:waiver_limit} waived late fees in a year the practice reviews the waiver. A session you move yourself with enough notice is a reschedule and carries no fee.
Reminders are sent {set:reminder_hours} hours before each session.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Late-cancel fee notice
paragraphs: Late-cancel fee notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:cancels.client}. Session {col:cancels.session_id} on {col:cancels.date} with {col:cancels.clinician}.
Status: {col:cancels.status}. Hours of notice given: {col:cancels.notice_hours}. Notice check: {col:cancels.notice_flag}. Session fee: {col:cancels.fee}.
Late-cancel fee charged: {col:cancels.fee_charged}, which is {set:late_fee_pct} of the session fee. Fee waived: {col:cancels.fee_given_up}.
The fee is added to your next invoice. Please speak to the practice if you would like it reviewed.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Fee waiver note

Session fee: {col:waivers.fee}. Amount waived: {col:waivers.fee_given_up}. Waived by {col:waivers.waived_by}. Reason: {col:waivers.reason}.
Waivers for this client in the last 12 months: {col:waivers.times_year}. Limit check: {col:waivers.limit_flag}. The practice limit is {set:waiver_limit} a year before a review.
The waiver is recorded and does not change the policy for later sessions.

Session cap {col:clin_weeks.cap}, days away {col:clin_weeks.days_away}, cap this week {col:clin_weeks.eff_cap}. Sessions booked: {col:clin_weeks.booked}. Free slots: {col:clin_weeks.free_slots}. Booked share of cap: {col:clin_weeks.share_of_cap}.

Load check: {col:clin_weeks.cap_flag}. Target band: {set:band_low} to {set:band_high} sessions a week. Back-to-back sessions: {col:clin_weeks.back_to_back}. Online or phone sessions: {col:clin_weeks.online}.

From {col:room_bookings.time} to {col:room_bookings.end_time} ({col:room_bookings.minutes} minutes). Use: {col:room_bookings.use}. Clinician: {col:room_bookings.clinician}. Service: {col:room_bookings.service}. Clash check: {col:room_bookings.clash}.

documents.title: Online session guide for a client
paragraphs: Online session guide of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:online.client}. Session {col:online.session_id} on {col:online.date}, {col:online.minutes} minutes with {col:online.clinician}.
Before the session: choose a quiet private place, check that your connection is stable, charge your device and use headphones if you can. The link and details are sent to you by e-mail.
If the call drops: wait two minutes and reconnect with the same link. If you cannot, call the practice and your clinician will phone you. Minutes lost to a technical problem are not charged again.
Details sent: {col:online.details_sent}. Problem check: {col:online.problem_flag}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Clinician absence notice to clients
paragraphs: Absence notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Your clinician, {col:absences.clinician}, is away in the week of {col:absences.week} ({col:absences.days} days, {col:absences.kind}).
{col:absences.sessions_moved} sessions are affected. Cover check: {col:absences.cover_flag}. Cover clinician: {col:absences.cover_by}.
We will call you to offer a session with the cover clinician or a new time. There is no late-cancel fee for a session moved because of an absence.
Thank you for your patience.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Practice closure notice for a week
paragraphs: Practice closure notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Week of {col:clin_weeks.week}: {col:clin_weeks.days_away} days away for {col:clin_weeks.clinician}.
Sessions booked that week: {col:clin_weeks.booked}. Cap that week: {col:clin_weeks.eff_cap}. Sessions affected are moved to the weeks before or after.
Clients are told at least two weeks before the closure. In an urgent need, clients are given the contact details of an outside service.
The next regular session of every client is booked before the closure.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Sublet agreement summary (adapt to your own terms)
paragraphs: Sublet agreement summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Tenant: {col:sublets.tenant}. Room: {col:sublets.room}.

Rate per hour: {col:sublets.rate}. Hours in {col:sublets.month}: {col:sublets.hours}. Amount for the month: {col:sublets.amount}. The tenant uses the room only for their own clients and leaves it reset.
Invoices are sent after the month ends and are due within 14 days. The practice may change the rate with notice. This summary does not replace your written contract.
Check your own local rules and your contract terms.

Room: {col:sublets.room}. Hours: {col:sublets.hours} at {col:sublets.rate} an hour. Amount due: {col:sublets.amount}. Status: {col:sublets.status}. Payment check: {col:sublets.pay_flag}.
